15.en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

15.zh: 基伊拉、亚革悉、玛利沙，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

15.zh: 又有以革伦和属以革伦的镇市村庄；
15.en: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

15.zh: 从以革伦直到海，一切靠近亚实突之地，并属其地的村庄。
15.en: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

15.zh: 亚实突和属亚实突的镇市村庄；迦萨和属迦萨的镇市村庄；直到埃及小河，并大海和靠近大海之地。
15.en: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

15.zh: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、
15.en: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

15.zh: 大拿、基列·萨拿（基列·萨拿就是底璧）、
15.en: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

15.zh: 亚拿伯、以实提莫、亚念、
15.en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

15.zh: 歌珊、何伦、基罗，共十一座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

15.zh: 又有亚拉、度玛、以珊、
15.en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

15.zh: 雅农、伯·他普亚、亚非加、
15.en: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

15.zh: 宏他、基列·亚巴（基列·亚巴就是希伯 ）、洗珥，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

15.zh: 又有玛云、迦密、西弗、淤他、
15.en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

15.zh: 耶斯列、约甸、撒挪亚、
15.en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

15.zh: 该隐、基比亚、亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

15.zh: 又有哈忽、伯·夙、基突、
15.en: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

15.zh: 玛腊、伯·亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

15.zh: 又有基列·巴力（基列·巴力就是基列·耶琳）、拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

15.zh: 在旷野有伯·亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
15.en: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

15.zh: 匿珊、盐城、隐·基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
15.en: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

15.zh: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。
15.en: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

16.zh: 约瑟的子孙拈阄所得之地是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，以耶利哥东边的水为界：从耶利哥上去，通过山地的旷野，到伯特利；
16.en: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

16.zh: 又从伯特利到路斯，接连到亚基人的境界，至亚他绿；
16.en: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

16.zh: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯·和 的境界，直到基色，通到海为止。
16.en: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

16.zh: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西、以法莲就得了他们的地业。
16.en: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

16.zh: 以法莲子孙的境界，按着宗族所得的，记在下面：他们地业的东界是亚他绿·亚达到上伯·和 ；
16.en: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

16.zh: 往西通到北边的密米他，又向东绕到他纳·示罗，又接连到雅挪哈的东边；
16.en: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

16.zh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约旦河为止；
16.en: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

16.zh: 从他普亚往西，到加拿河，直通到海为止。这就是以法莲支派按着宗族所得的地业。
16.en: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

16.zh: 另外在玛拿西人地业中得了些城邑和属城的村庄。这都是分给以法莲子孙的。
16.en: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

16.zh: 他们没有赶出住基色的迦南人；迦南人却住在以法莲人中间，成为做苦工的仆人，直到今日。
16.en: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

17.zh: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派拈阄所得之地记在下面。至于玛拿西的长子基列之父玛吉，因为是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。
17.en: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

17.zh: 玛拿西其余的子孙，按着宗族[拈阄分地]，就是亚比以谢子孙，希勒子孙，亚斯列子孙，示剑子孙，希弗子孙，示米大子孙；这些按着宗族，都是约瑟儿子玛拿西子孙的男丁。
17.en: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

17.zh: 玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿。他的女儿名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒；
17.en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

17.zh: 她们来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚并众首领面前，说：「耶和华曾吩咐摩西在我们弟兄中分给我们产业。」于是约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，在她们伯叔中，把产业分给她们。
17.en: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

17.zh: 除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十分地归玛拿西，
17.en: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

17.zh: 因为玛拿西的孙女们在玛拿西的孙子中得了产业。基列地是属玛拿西其余的子孙。
17.en: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

17.zh: 玛拿西的境界：从亚设起，到示剑前的密米他，往北到隐·他普亚居民[之地]。
17.en: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

17.zh: 他普亚地归玛拿西，只是玛拿西境界上的他普亚[城]归以法莲子孙。
17.en: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

17.zh: 其界下到加拿河的南边。在玛拿西城邑中的这些城邑都归以法莲。玛拿西的地界是在河北直通到海为止；
17.en: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

17.zh: 南归以法莲，北归玛拿西，以海为界；北边到亚设，东边到以萨迦。
17.en: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

17.zh: 玛拿西在以萨迦和亚设境内，有伯·善和属伯·善的镇市，以伯莲和属以伯莲的镇市，多珥的居民和属多珥的镇市；又有三处山冈，就是隐·多珥和属隐·多珥的镇市；他纳的居民和属他纳的镇市，米吉多的居民和属米吉多的镇市。
17.en: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

17.zh: 只是玛拿西子孙不能赶出这些城的[居民]，迦南人偏要住在那地。
17.en: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

17.zh: 及至以色列人强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。
17.en: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

17.zh: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说：「耶和华到如今既然赐福与我们，我们也族大人多，你为什么仅将一阄一段之地分给我们为业呢？」
17.en: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”

17.zh: 约书亚说：「你们如果族大人多，嫌以法莲山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人、利乏音人之地，在树林中砍伐[树木]。」
17.en: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

17.zh: 约瑟的子孙说：「那山地容不下我们，并且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯·善和属伯·善的镇市，并住耶斯列平原的人，都有铁车。」
17.en: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

17.zh: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是以法莲和玛拿西人，说：「你是族大人多，并且强盛，不可仅有一阄之地，
17.en: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

17.zh: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。」
17.en: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

18.zh: 以色列的全会众都聚集在示罗，把会幕设立在那里，那地已经被他们制伏了。
18.en: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

18.zh: 以色列人中其余的七个支派还没有分给他们地业。
18.en: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

18.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说：「耶和华—你们列祖的　神所赐给你们的地，你们耽延不去得，要到几时呢？
18.en: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

18.zh: 你们每支派当选举三个人，我要打发他们去，他们就要起身走遍那地，按着各支派[应得的]地业写明，就回到我这里来。
18.en: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

18.zh: 他们要将地分做七分；犹大仍在南方，住在他的境内。约瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境内。
18.en: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

18.zh: 你们要将地分做七分，写明了拿到我这里来。我要在耶和华—我们　神面前，为你们拈阄。
18.en: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

18.zh: 利未人在你们中间没有分，因为供耶和华祭司的职任就是他们的产业。迦得支派、吕便支派，和玛拿西半支派已经在约旦河东得了地业，就是耶和华仆人摩西所给他们的。」
18.en: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”

18.zh: 划地势的人起身去的时候，约书亚嘱咐他们说：「你们去走遍那地，划明地势，就回到我这里来。我要在示罗这里，耶和华面前，为你们拈阄。」
18.en: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”

18.zh: 他们就去了，走遍那地，按着城邑分做七分，写在册子上，回到示罗营中见约书亚。
18.en: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

18.zh: 约书亚就在示罗，耶和华面前，为他们拈阄。约书亚在那里，按着以色列人的支派，将地分给他们。
18.en: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

18.zh: 便雅悯支派，按着宗族拈阄所得之地，是在犹大、约瑟子孙中间。
18.en: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

18.zh: 他们的北界是从约旦河起，往上贴近耶利哥的北边；又往西通过山地，直到伯·亚文的旷野；
18.en: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

18.zh: 从那里往南接连到路斯，贴近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亚他绿·亚达，靠近下伯·和 南边的山；
18.en: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

18.zh: 从[那里]往西，又转向南，从伯·和 南对面的山，直达到犹大人的城基列·巴力（基列·巴力就是基列·耶琳）；这是西界。
18.en: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

18.zh: 南界是从基列·耶琳的尽边起，往西达到尼弗多亚的水源；
18.en: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

18.zh: 又下到欣嫩子谷对面山的尽边，就是利乏音谷北边的山；又下到欣嫩谷，贴近耶布斯的南边；又下到隐·罗结；
18.en: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

18.zh: 又往北通到隐·示麦，达到亚都冥坡对面的基利绿；又下到吕便之子波罕的磐石；
18.en: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

18.zh: 又接连到亚拉巴对面，往北下到亚拉巴；
18.en: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

18.zh: 又接连到伯·曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北汊，就是约旦河的南头；这是南界。
18.en: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

18.zh: 东界是约旦河。这是便雅悯人按着宗族，照他们四围的交界所得的地业。
18.en: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

18.zh: 便雅悯支派按着宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥、伯·曷拉、伊麦·基悉、
18.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

18.zh: 伯·亚拉巴、洗玛脸、伯特利、
18.en: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

18.zh: 亚文、巴拉、俄弗拉、
18.en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

18.zh: 基法·阿摩尼、俄弗尼、迦巴，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄；
18.en: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

18.zh: 又有基遍、拉玛、比录、
18.en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

18.zh: 米斯巴、基非拉、摩撒、
18.en: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

18.zh: 利坚、伊利毗勒、他拉拉、
18.en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

18.zh: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）、基比亚、基列，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。这是便雅悯人按着宗族所得的地业。
18.en: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

19.zh: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。
19.en: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

19.zh: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、
19.en: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

19.zh: 哈萨·书亚、巴拉、以森、
19.en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

19.zh: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥玛、
19.en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

19.zh: 洗革拉、伯·玛加博、哈萨·苏撒、
19.en: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

19.zh: 伯·利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；
19.en: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

19.zh: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；
19.en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

19.zh: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉·比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

19.zh: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。
19.en: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

19.zh: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立；
19.en: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

19.zh: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；
19.en: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

19.zh: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿·他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
19.en: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

19.zh: 从那里往东，接连到迦特·希弗，至以特·加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；
19.en: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

19.zh: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他·伊勒谷。
19.en: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

19.zh: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸 、以大拉、伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

19.zh: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四阄。
19.en: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

19.zh: 他们的境界是到耶斯列、基苏律、书念、
19.en: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

19.zh: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、
19.en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

19.zh: 拉璧、基善、亚别、
19.en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

19.zh: 利篾、隐·干宁、隐·哈大、伯·帕薛；
19.en: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

19.zh: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯·示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

19.zh: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五阄。
19.en: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

19.zh: 他们的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
19.en: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

19.zh: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷·立纳，
19.en: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

19.zh: 转向日出之地，到伯·大衮，达到细步纶；往北到伊弗他·伊勒谷，到伯·以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；
19.en: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

19.zh: 又到义伯 、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；
19.en: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

19.zh: 转到拉玛和坚固城泰尔；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；
19.en: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

19.zh: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

19.zh: 为拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六阄。
19.en: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

19.zh: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米·尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河；
19.en: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

19.zh: 又转向西到亚斯纳·他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。
19.en: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

19.zh: 坚固的城就是：西丁、侧耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、
19.en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

19.zh: 亚大玛、拉玛、夏琐、
19.en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

19.zh: 基低斯、以得来、隐·夏琐、
19.en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

19.zh: 以利稳、密大·伊勒、和琏、伯·亚纳、伯·示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。
19.en: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

19.zh: 为但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七阄。
19.en: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

19.zh: 他们地业的境界是琐拉、以实陶、伊珥·示麦、
19.en: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

19.zh: 沙拉宾、亚雅 、伊提拉、
19.en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

19.zh: 以伦、亭拿他、以革伦、
19.en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

19.zh: 伊利提基、基比顿、巴拉、
19.en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

19.zh: 伊胡得、比尼·比拉、迦特·临门、
19.en: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

19.zh: 美·耶昆、拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。
19.en: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

19.zh: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。
19.en: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

19.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按着宗族所得的地业。
19.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

19.zh: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，
19.en: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

19.zh: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿·西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
19.en: According to the LORD’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

19.zh: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。
19.en: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

20.en: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

20.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们要照着我借摩西所晓谕你们的，为自己设立逃城，
20.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

20.zh: 使那无心而误杀人的，可以逃到那里。这些城可以作你们逃避报血仇人的地方。
20.en: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

20.zh: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座城，站在城门口，将他的事情说给城内的长老们听。他们就把他收进城里，给他地方，使他住在他们中间。
20.en: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

20.zh: 若是报血仇的追了他来，长老不可将他交在报血仇的手里；因为他是素无仇恨，无心杀了人的。
20.en: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

20.zh: 他要住在那城里，站在会众面前听审判，等到那时的大祭司死了，杀人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出来的那城。」
20.en: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

20.zh: 于是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法莲山地分定示剑；在犹大山地分定基列·亚巴（基列·亚巴就是希伯 ）；
20.en: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

20.zh: 又在约旦河外耶利哥东，从吕便支派中，在旷野的平原，设立比悉；从迦得支派中设立基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中设立巴珊的哥兰。
20.en: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

20.zh: 这都是为以色列众人和在他们中间寄居的外人所分定的城邑，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里，不死在报血仇人的手中，等他站在会众面前[听审判]。
20.en: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

21.zh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，
21.en: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

21.zh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说：「从前耶和华借着摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。」
21.en: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

21.zh: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。
21.en: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with their pasture lands.

21.zh: 为哥辖族拈阄：利未人的祭司、亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派、便雅悯支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
21.en: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

21.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派、但支派、玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十座城。
21.en: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

21.zh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
21.en: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

21.zh: 米拉利的子孙，按着宗族，从吕便支派、迦得支派、西布伦支派的地业中，[按阄]得了十二座城。
21.en: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

21.zh: 以色列人照着耶和华借摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按阄分给利未人。
21.en: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as the LORD commanded by Moses.

21.zh: 从犹大支派、西缅支派的地业中，将以下所记的城给了利未支派哥辖宗族亚伦的子孙；因为给他们拈出头一阄，
21.en: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

21.zh: 将犹大山地的基列·亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列·亚巴就是希伯 ）。
21.en: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

21.zh: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。
21.en: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

21.zh: 以色列人将希伯 ，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙；又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，
21.en: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，
21.en: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 何 和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，
21.en: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯·示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。
21.en: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

21.zh: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。
21.en: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

21.zh: 利未[支派]中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈阄所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。
21.en: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

21.zh: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们基色和属城的郊野，
21.en: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯·和 和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 亚雅 和属城的郊野，迦特·临门和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从玛拿西半支派的地业中给了他们他纳和属城的郊野，迦特·临门和属城的郊野，共两座城。
21.en: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

21.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙共有十座城，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

21.zh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半支派的地业中将巴珊的哥兰，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了利未支派革顺的子孙；又给他们比·施提拉和属城的郊野，共两座城；
21.en: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

21.zh: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐·干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从亚设支派的地业中给了他们米沙勒和属城的郊野，押顿和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 黑甲和属城的郊野，利合和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从拿弗他利支派的地业中将加利利的基低斯，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们哈末·多珥和属城的郊野，加珥坦和属城的郊野，共三座城。
21.en: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

21.zh: 革顺人按着宗族[所得的]城，共十三座，还有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

21.zh: 其余利未支派米拉利子孙，从西布伦支派的地业中所得的，就是约念和属城的郊野，加珥他和属城的郊野，
21.en: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 丁拿和属城的郊野，拿哈拉和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从吕便支派的地业中给了他们比悉和属城的郊野，雅杂和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 基底莫和属城的郊野，米法押和属城的郊野，共四座城；
21.en: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

21.zh: 又从迦得支派的地业中，将基列的拉末，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们玛哈念和属城的郊野，
21.en: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

21.zh: 希实本和属城的郊野，雅谢和属城的郊野，共四座城。
21.en: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

21.zh: 其余利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孙，按着宗族拈阄所得的，共十二座城。
21.en: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

21.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地业中所得的城，共四十八座，并有属城的郊野。
21.en: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

21.zh: 这些城四围都有属城的郊野，城城都是如此。
21.en: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

21.zh: 这样，耶和华将从前向他们列祖起誓所应许的全地赐给以色列人，他们就得了为业，住在其中。
21.en: So the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

21.zh: 耶和华照着向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安；他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。
21.en: The LORD gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. The LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

21.zh: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。
21.en: Nothing failed of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

22.zh: 当时，约书亚召了吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人来，
22.en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

22.zh: 对他们说：「耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的，你们都遵守了；我所吩咐你们的，你们也都听从了。
22.en: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

22.zh: 你们这许多日子，总没有撇离你们的弟兄，直到今日，并守了耶和华—你们　神所吩咐你们当守的。
22.en: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of the LORD your God.

22.zh: 如今耶和华—你们　神照着他所应许的，使你们弟兄得享平安，现在可以转回你们的帐棚，到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐你们为业之地。
22.en: Now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.

22.zh: 只要切切地谨慎遵行耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的诫命律法，爱耶和华—你们的　神，行他一切的道，守他的诫命，专靠他，尽心尽性事奉他。」
22.en: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

22.zh: 于是约书亚为他们祝福，打发他们去，他们就回自己的帐棚去了。
22.en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

22.zh: 玛拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分给他们[地业]。这半支派，约书亚在约旦河西，在他们弟兄中，分给他们[地业]。约书亚打发他们回帐棚的时候为他们祝福，
22.en: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

22.zh: 对他们说：「你们带许多财物，许多牲畜和金、银、铜、铁，并许多衣服，回你们的帐棚去，要将你们从仇敌夺来的物，与你们众弟兄同分。」
22.en: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

22.zh: 于是吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人从迦南地的示罗起行，离开以色列人，回往他们得为业的基列地，就是照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的得了为业之地。
22.en: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

22.zh: 吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人到了靠近约旦河的一带迦南地，就在约旦河那里筑了一座坛；那坛看着高大。
22.en: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

22.zh: 以色列人听说吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人靠近约旦河边，在迦南地属以色列人的那边筑了一座坛。
22.en: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

22.zh: 全会众一听见，就聚集在示罗，要上去攻打他们。
22.en: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

22.zh: 以色列人打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，往基列地去见吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人；
22.en: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

22.zh: 又打发十个首领与非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一个首领，都是以色列军中的统领。
22.en: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

22.zh: 他们到了基列地，见吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，对他们说：
22.en: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

22.zh: 「耶和华全会众这样说，你们今日转去不跟从耶和华，干犯以色列的　神，为自己筑一座坛，悖逆了耶和华，这犯的是什么罪呢？
22.en: “The whole congregation of the LORD says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following the LORD, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against the LORD?

22.zh: 从前[拜]毗珥的罪孽还算小吗？虽然瘟疫临到耶和华的会众，到今日我们还没有洗净这罪。
22.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of the LORD,

22.zh: 你们今日竟转去不跟从耶和华吗？你们今日既悖逆耶和华，明日他必向以色列全会众发怒。
22.en: that you must turn away today from following the LORD? It will be, since you rebel today against the LORD, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

22.zh: 你们所得为业之地，若嫌不洁净，就可以过到耶和华之地，就是耶和华的帐幕所住之地，在我们中间得地业。只是不可悖逆耶和华，也不可得罪我们，在耶和华—我们　神的坛以外为自己筑坛。
22.en: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than the LORD our God’s altar.

22.zh: 从前谢拉的曾孙亚干岂不是在那当灭的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒临到以色列全会众吗？那人在所犯的罪中不独一人死亡。」
22.en: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

22.zh: 于是吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人回答以色列军中的统领说：
22.en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

22.zh: 「大能者　神耶和华！大能者　神耶和华！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我们若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和华（愿你今日不保佑我们），
22.en: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against the LORD (don’t save us today),

22.zh: 为自己筑坛，要转去不跟从耶和华，或是要将燔祭、素祭、平安祭献在坛上，愿耶和华亲自讨我们的罪。
22.en: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let the LORD himself require it.

22.zh: 我们行这事并非无故，是特意做的，说：恐怕日后你们的子孙对我们的子孙说：『你们与耶和华—以色列的　神有何关涉呢？
22.en: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

22.zh: 因为耶和华把约旦河定为我们和你们这吕便人、迦得人的交界，你们与耶和华无分了。』这样，你们的子孙就使我们的子孙不再敬畏耶和华了。
22.en: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

22.zh: 因此我们说：『不如为自己筑一座坛，不是为献燔祭，也不是为献[别的]祭，
22.en: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

22.zh: 乃是为你我中间和你我后人中间作证据，好叫我们也在耶和华面前献燔祭、平安祭，和[别的]祭事奉他，免得你们的子孙日后对我们的子孙说，你们与耶和华无分了。』
22.en: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in the LORD.’

22.zh: 所以我们说：『日后你们对我们，或对我们的后人这样说，我们就可以回答说，你们看我们列祖所筑的坛是耶和华坛的样式；这并不是为献燔祭，也不是为献[别的]祭，乃是为作你我中间的证据。』
22.en: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of the LORD’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

22.zh: 我们在耶和华—我们　神帐幕前的坛以外，另筑一座坛，为献燔祭、素祭，和[别的]祭，悖逆耶和华，今日转去不跟从他，我们断没有这个意思。」
22.en: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn away today from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides the LORD our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

22.zh: 祭司非尼哈与会中的首领，就是与他同来以色列军中的统领，听见吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西人所说的话，就都以为美。
22.en: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

22.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈对吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西人说：「今日我们知道耶和华在我们中间，因为你们没有向他犯了这罪。现在你们救以色列人脱离耶和华的手了。」
22.en: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD’s hand.”

22.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈与众首领离了吕便人、迦得人，从基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那里，[便将这事]回报他们。
22.en: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

22.zh: 以色列人以这事为美，就称颂　神，不再提上去攻打吕便人、迦得人、毁坏他们所住的地了。
22.en: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

22.zh: 吕便人、迦得人给坛起名叫[证坛]，意思说：这坛在我们中间证明耶和华是　神。
22.en: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”

23.zh: 耶和华使以色列人安静，不与四围的一切仇敌争战，已经多日。约书亚年纪老迈，
23.en: After many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

23.zh: 就把以色列众人的长老、族长、审判官，并官长都召了来，对他们说：「我年纪已经老迈。
23.en: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

23.zh: 耶和华—你们的　神因你们的缘故向那些国所行的一切事，你们亲眼看见了，因那为你们争战的是耶和华—你们的　神。
23.en: You have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the LORD your God who has fought for you.

23.zh: 我所剪除和所剩下的各国，从约旦河起到日落之处的大海，我已经拈阄分给你们各支派为业。
23.en: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

23.zh: 耶和华—你们的　神必将他们从你们面前赶出去，使他们离开你们，你们就必得他们的地为业，正如耶和华—你们的　神所应许的。
23.en: The LORD your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as the LORD your God spoke to you.

23.zh: 所以，你们要大大壮胆，谨守遵行写在摩西律法书上的一切话，不可偏离左右。
23.en: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

23.zh: 不可与你们中间所剩下的这些国民搀杂。他们的神，你们不可提他的名，不可指着他起誓，也不可事奉、叩拜；
23.en: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

23.zh: 只要照着你们到今日所行的，专靠耶和华—你们的　神。
23.en: but hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

23.zh: 因为耶和华已经把又大又强的国民从你们面前赶出；直到今日，没有一人在你们面前站立得住。
23.en: “For the LORD has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

23.zh: 你们一人必追赶千人，因耶和华—你们的　神照他所应许的，为你们争战。
23.en: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is the LORD your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

23.zh: 你们要分外谨慎，爱耶和华—你们的　神。
23.en: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.

23.zh: 你们若稍微转去，与你们中间所剩下的这些国民联络，彼此结亲，互相往来，
23.en: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

23.zh: 你们要确实知道，耶和华—你们的　神必不再将他们从你们眼前赶出；他们却要成为你们的网罗、机槛、肋上的鞭、眼中的刺，直到你们在耶和华—你们　神所赐的这美地上灭亡。
23.en: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.

23.zh: 「我现在要走世人必走的路。你们是一心一意地知道，耶和华—你们　神所应许赐福与你们的话没有一句落空，都应验在你们身上了。
23.en: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

23.zh: 耶和华—你们　神所应许的一切福气怎样临到你们身上，耶和华也必照样使各样祸患临到你们身上，直到把你们从耶和华—你们　神所赐的这美地上除灭。
23.en: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which the LORD your God spoke to you, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you,

23.zh: 你们若违背耶和华—你们　神吩咐你们所守的约，去事奉别神，叩拜他，耶和华的怒气必向你们发作，使你们在他所赐的美地上速速灭亡。」
23.en: when you disobey the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then the LORD’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

24.zh: 约书亚将以色列的众支派聚集在示剑，召了以色列的长老、族长、审判官，并官长来，他们就站在　神面前。
24.en: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

24.zh: 约书亚对众民说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『古时你们的列祖，就是亚伯拉罕和拿鹤的父亲他拉，住在大河那边事奉别神，
24.en: Joshua said to all the people, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

24.zh: 我将你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕从大河那边带来，领他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孙众多，把以撒赐给他；
24.en: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

24.zh: 又把雅各和以扫赐给以撒，将西珥山赐给以扫为业；后来雅各和他的子孙下到埃及去了。
24.en: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

24.zh: 我差遣摩西、亚伦，并照我在埃及中所行的降灾与埃及，然后把你们领出来。
24.en: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

24.zh: 我领你们列祖出埃及，他们就到了红海；埃及人带领车辆马兵追赶你们列祖到红海。
24.en: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

24.zh: 你们列祖哀求耶和华，他就使你们和埃及人中间黑暗了，又使海水淹没埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你们亲眼见过。你们在旷野也住了许多年日。
24.en: When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

24.zh: 我领你们到约旦河东亚摩利人所住之地。他们与你们争战，我将他们交在你们手中，你们便得了他们的地为业；我也在你们面前将他们灭绝。
24.en: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

24.zh: 那时，摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒起来攻击以色列人，打发人召了比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。
24.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

24.zh: 我不肯听巴兰的话，所以他倒为你们连连祝福。这样，我便救你们脱离巴勒的手。
24.en: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

24.zh: 你们过了约旦河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、迦南人、赫人、革迦撒人、希未人、耶布斯人都与你们争战；我把他们交在你们手里。
24.en: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

24.zh: 我打发黄蜂飞在你们前面，将亚摩利人的二王从你们面前撵出，并不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。
24.en: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

24.zh: 我赐给你们地土，非你们所修治的；我赐给你们城邑，非你们所建造的。你们就住在其中，又得吃非你们所栽种的葡萄园、橄榄园的果子。』
24.en: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

24.zh: 「现在你们要敬畏耶和华，诚心实意地事奉他，将你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。
24.en: “Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.

24.zh: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。」
24.en: If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

24.zh: 百姓回答说：「我们断不敢离弃耶和华去事奉别神；
24.en: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

24.zh: 因耶和华—我们的　神曾将我们和我们列祖从埃及地的为奴之家领出来，在我们眼前行了那些大神迹，在我们所行的道上，所经过的诸国，都保护了我们。
24.en: for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

24.zh: 耶和华又把住此地的亚摩利人都从我们面前赶出去。所以，我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的　神。」
24.en: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the LORD; for he is our God.”

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们不能事奉耶和华；因为他是圣洁的　神，是忌邪的　神，必不赦免你们的过犯罪恶。
24.en: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

24.zh: 你们若离弃耶和华去事奉外邦神，耶和华在降福之后，必转而降祸与你们，把你们灭绝。」
24.en: If you forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

24.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：「不然，我们定要事奉耶和华。」
24.en: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们选定耶和华，要事奉他，你们自己作见证吧！」他们说：「我们愿意作见证。」
24.en: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the LORD yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

24.zh: 约书亚说：「你们现在要除掉你们中间的外邦神，专心归向耶和华—以色列的　神。」
24.en: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD, the God of Israel.”

24.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：「我们必事奉耶和华—我们的　神，听从他的话。」
24.en: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

24.zh: 当日，约书亚就与百姓立约，在示剑为他们立定律例典章。
24.en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

24.zh: 约书亚将这些话都写在　神的律法书上，又将一块大石头立在橡树下耶和华的圣所旁边。
24.en: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

24.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「看哪，这石头可以向我们作见证；因为是听见了耶和华所吩咐我们的一切话，倘或你们背弃你们的　神，这石头就可以向你们作见证。」
24.en: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the LORD’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

24.zh: 于是约书亚打发百姓各归自己的地业去了。
24.en: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

24.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。
24.en: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being one hundred ten years old.

24.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿·西拉，在迦实山的北边。
24.en: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

24.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行诸事的长老还在的时候，以色列人事奉耶和华。
24.en: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of the LORD, that he had worked for Israel.

24.zh: 以色列人从埃及所带来约瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示剑，就是在雅各从前用一百块[银子]向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙所买的那块地里；这就作了约瑟子孙的产业。
24.en: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

24.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了，就把他葬在他儿子非尼哈所得以法莲山地的小山上。
24.en: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
